cases.purpose: sudo -i starts the target's login shell in the target's home (a missing home is reported and the shell starts where it is), sudo -s runs the invoking shell from $SHELL (falling back to the invoking account's shell), and the command string handed to the shell escapes every byte except letters, digits, underscore, hyphen and dollar with a backslash (empty and newline words single-quoted), so the shell reconstructs the original words.
cases.oracle: sudo(8) -i/-s semantics as pinned in the source comment for sudo 1.9.16p2: a bash model of the escape rule computes the expected command string, the shell probe prints its own argv from /proc/PID/cmdline and the target shell itself reports its working directory, HOME, login-shell state and BASH_VERSION; direct execution of a helper gives the expected word list.
cases.comparison: Exact stdout: the login shell's own report for an existing and a missing home, the shell kind chosen under three SHELL settings, byte equality of the -c string with the independent model, and whether the executed helper received the original words (with the documented $HOME expansion).
cases.script:
P=$PWD
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers
cat > "$P/passwd.fx" <<'X'
root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash
alice:x:3001:3001:Alice:/tmp/parity-case/home-alice:/bin/bash
bob:x:3002:3002:Bob:/tmp/parity-case/no-such-home:/bin/bash
X
cat > "$P/group.fx" <<'X'
root:x:0:
alice:x:3001:alice
bob:x:3002:
staff:x:4000:alice
wheel:x:4001:alice,bob
ops:x:5000:
X
/usr/bin/mount --bind "$P/passwd.fx" /etc/passwd || echo "MOUNT-FAIL passwd"
/usr/bin/mount --bind "$P/group.fx" /etc/group || echo "MOUNT-FAIL group"
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 755 "$P/home-alice"
snap() { local l; set -f; while IFS= read -r l; do case $l in Uid:*|Gid:*|Groups:*|NoNewPrivs:*) echo $l;; esac; done < /proc/$BASHPID/status; set +f; }

cat > "$P/show.sh" <<'X'
#!/bin/bash
set -f
while IFS= read -r l; do case $l in Uid:*|Gid:*|Groups:*|NoNewPrivs:*) echo $l;; esac; done < /proc/self/status
X
/usr/bin/chmod 755 "$P/show.sh"

cat > "$P/argv.sh" <<'X'
#!/bin/bash
echo "argc=$#"; for a in "$@"; do printf '<%s>\n' "$a"; done
X
cat > "$P/cmdprobe" <<'X'
#!/bin/bash
printf '%s' "$2"
X
/usr/bin/chmod 755 "$P/argv.sh" "$P/cmdprobe"
report='while IFS= read -r -d "" a; do printf "[%s]" "$a"; done < /proc/$$/cmdline; echo; echo "cwd=$PWD home=$HOME"; shopt -q login_shell && echo login=yes || echo login=no; echo shell=$SHELL'
echo "--- login existing home"
printf '%s\n' "$report" | sudo -i -u alice 2>&1 | while IFS= read -r l; do echo "i $l"; done
echo "--- login missing home"
printf '%s\n' "$report" | sudo -i -u bob 2>&1 | while IFS= read -r l; do echo "m $l"; done
echo "--- shell selection"
for sh in /bin/sh /bin/bash; do
  out=$(printf 'echo bash=${BASH_VERSION:+yes}\n' | SHELL=$sh sudo -s -u alice 2>&1); echo "SHELL=$sh $out"
done
unset SHELL
out=$(printf 'echo bash=${BASH_VERSION:+yes}\n' | sudo -s -u alice 2>&1); echo "SHELL=unset $out"
echo "--- escaping"
esc() { local s=$1 out= c i; for ((i=0; i<${#s}; i++)); do c=${s:i:1}; case $c in [A-Za-z0-9_\$-]) out+=$c;; *) out+="\\$c";; esac; done; printf '%s' "$out"; }
mw() { local w=$1; if [[ -z $w || $w == *$'\n'* ]]; then w=${w//\'/\'\\\'\'}; printf "'%s'" "$w"; else esc "$w"; fi; }
words=("$P/argv.sh" 'a b' "it's" '*' ';' '&&' '|' '<' '>' '"dq"' 'back\slash' '' $'nl\nx' '#hash' '~' '$HOME' $'x\n$HOME' 'tab	tab')
model=; for w in "${words[@]}"; do model+="${model:+ }$(mw "$w")"; done
got=$(SHELL="$P/cmdprobe" sudo -s -u alice "${words[@]}")
[[ $got == "$model" ]] && echo "command-string=matches-model" || echo "command-string=DIFFERS"
hm=/tmp/parity-case/home-alice
exec_out=$(SHELL=/bin/bash sudo -s -u alice "${words[@]}" 2>&1)
want_args=("${words[@]:1}"); want_args[14]=$hm
want=$("$P/argv.sh" "${want_args[@]}")
[[ $exec_out == "$want" ]] && echo "words-reconstructed=yes count=$(( ${#words[@]} - 1 ))" || echo "words-reconstructed=NO"
cases.stdout:
--- login existing home
i [-bash][-l]
i cwd=/tmp/parity-case/home-alice home=/tmp/parity-case/home-alice
i login=yes
i shell=/bin/bash
--- login missing home
m sudo: unable to change directory to /tmp/parity-case/no-such-home: No such file or directory
m [-bash][-l]
m cwd=/tmp/parity-case home=/tmp/parity-case/no-such-home
m login=yes
m shell=/bin/bash
--- shell selection
SHELL=/bin/sh bash=
SHELL=/bin/bash bash=yes
SHELL=unset bash=yes
--- escaping
command-string=matches-model
words-reconstructed=yes count=17
